svg.text: A MERN single-page app. React talks only to the Express API, and the API owns the database and every third-party key.
BROWSER · React 18 + React Router + Tailwind, served by Vite on :3000
HTTP · JSON — Vite proxies every /api/* call to :5000
verifies the JWT and loads the
user; admin gate layered on top
Mongoose ODM — the server still boots when MONGO_URI is unset
Outbound only, and always from the server.
Keys live in server/.env, so the browser
